name: klikindomaret-scraper
title: Klikindomaret (Indomaret Xpress) Scraper
description: Scrape Indomaret Klik Xpress groceries: product listings (price, discount, promo, stock) by keyword or category, the category tree, promo banners, search suggestions, and store resolution. HTTP-only internal API; auto-solves AWS WAF + Cloudflare. No login.
